en: Colorized panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley surrounded by steep rocky mountains. The foreground shows dense red‑tiled roofs, narrow streets, and a prominent church with a bell tower. The mid‑ground opens into cultivated fields and additional buildings stretching toward the base of the mountains. At the top left, printed text reads the town name and the word 'Panorama.' The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century touristic postcard.
